verses.pali: “Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, parihīnaṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati parihīnā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, those who have lost mindfulness of the body have lost freedom from death.

verses.pali: Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, aparihīnaṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati aparihīnā”ti.
verses.english: Those who haven’t lost mindfulness of the body haven’t lost freedom from death.”
